independent_checks.finding: The induced polynomial exact sequence raises global dimension by at most one; localization preserves that bound. The comparison construction is valid even without projective lifts: pullback is a kernel of an epimorphism P0+ Cprime -> C, so belongs to C. Induction on the target resolution length then resolves Y -> Z. Diagonal comparison gives resolution independence, and the cone gives additivity.

Clearing denominators and torsion kernel/cokernel prove the displayed right-exact sequence. The t-power filtration kills the localization kernel. The maximal counterexample-quotient argument, nilradical filtration, finite minimal-prime decomposition of the total quotient ring, and transfer from A/sA together prove polynomial invariance; the displayed specialization Euler characteristic supplies injectivity. No circular use of K0 polynomial invariance occurs.

The equivariant free shift surjection has decreasing projective dimension until a projective kernel; nilpotence survives. Nil devissage and the Euler-resolution lemma identify K0(Nil_P) with K0(A), making tau zero. For the displayed Higman step, left multiplication by E12(C s^(n-1)) followed by right multiplication by E21(-sI) gives exactly the claimed block matrix. Its polynomial degree drops, and a polynomial inverse of I-s nu forces nilpotence by coefficient comparison. No invalid Laurent-inverse nilpotence inference is used.

For pd_B M<=1 and t^N M=0, the stated Tor sequence is two-periodic over A with A-projective middle terms. Finite A global dimension forces Ext^1_A(M,-)=0. Conversely the characteristic sequence gives pd_B<=1. H-resolutions of torsion modules terminate since kernel pd <= max(1,pd M-1). K0(B)=Z gives equality of presentation projectives; adding one common projective and then a common complement genuinely produces a square free presentation.

Modulo the quotient, E12(f) E21(-g) E12(f) J induces diag(theta,theta^-1). With theta the swap, the first quotient component of theta is the other quotient and hence pi2 Gamma=gamma pi1. Gamma therefore maps ker pi1 isomorphically to ker pi2. The displayed D_alpha,D_beta are the correct free identifications of these kernels. Gamma D_alpha=D_beta Gamma1 proves presentation independence modulo image K1(B); no unjustified simultaneous stabilization or lifting an invertible quotient map to an invertible single free map is used.

The cokernel product sequence makes partial a stable abelian homomorphism. Horseshoe presentations give additivity of a. The two formulas partial a=id and a partial=id hold including the denominator correction q m[A]. Thus K1(C)/image K1(B)=K0(H), split by t. Polynomial invariance and evaluation t=1 give injectivity of the old summand. Euclidean reduction supplies K1(Z)=C2; induction yields C2+Z^r with explicit unit generators. Therefore reduced K0 and Wh vanish for all finite r.
